notes: AUTHORIZED - mechanically implied by making the outline argument required. message: statement-api must extend contract/src/measure.ts because DomainSpec.composed.joinKeys is hard-coded to gl_code/month while decision 0022 requires the registered statement domain to declare leaf_key/month; using gl_code would make the semantic contract false

notes: AUTHORIZED - mechanically implied, and verified: contract/src/measure.ts:59 types joinKeys as the literal tuple ['gl_code', 'month'], so a statement_relation domain joining on leaf_key cannot be declared at all without widening it. Registering that domain is this task's FIRST acceptance criterion, so the type is not optional scope. Widen joinKeys to accept the statement grain (a readonly string tuple, or a union that admits ['leaf_key','month']) WITHOUT loosening it into plain string[] - the literal type is what stops a domain declaring a join the builder cannot honour, and decision 0022 keeps the (gl_code, month) relation intact, so the existing composed domain must still type-check unchanged. Recorded on the stage with amend-scope.

message: The blocking statement SQL authorization fix requires backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts: the route must select leaf_key, but SelectionExecutor automatically executes a second totals query whenever dimensions are selected, contradicting the once-per-range acceptance criterion. Add a minimal includeTotals/skipTotals option and use it from mis-statement.service.ts, or amend the contract with another sanctioned design.

notes: AUTHORIZED, with constraints. Verified at selectionExecutor.ts:84-87: whenever dimensionIds is non-empty the executor runs a SECOND ungrouped query via totalsFor, so the statement would issue two queries per period block - four in all - contradicting the once-per-range criterion. Those totals are also genuinely unused: the statement derives its grand total by folding leaves (decision 0020), so the second scan is pure waste, not a safety net. Add a MINIMAL additive option (includeTotals defaulting to TODAY'S behaviour) and pass it false from mis-statement.service.ts. Constraints: the default must be unchanged so no existing caller's behaviour moves; do not alter totalsFor itself; and the composed executor tests must pass unchanged, since every other consumer still relies on the automatic totals. backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts and its test are recorded on the stage with amend-scope.

message: Removing the obsolete frontend runMisSelection API requires deleting its sole caller frontend/src/features/mis/use-mis-selection.ts, but that file is absent from the declared write scope; add it so the blocking review fix can compile.

notes: AUTHORIZED - mechanically implied by the blocking review fix, and verified: frontend/src/features/mis/use-mis-selection.ts is the sole remaining caller of runMisSelection, and the page now imports useMisStatement instead (mis-report-view.tsx:7,11), so the hook is orphaned. Removing the client method without deleting its only caller would not compile. Delete the hook file and its api.test.ts case along with the method. Leave the BACKEND /api/mis/run route untouched - it is mis-selection's shipped contract and drill-down may consume it; this is the frontend's dead entry point only. Recorded on the stage with amend-scope.
